community.name: Inukjuak
community.facebookPageNote: Set the verified community page URL after confirming the page and its primary/backup publishers.

thresholds.note: 0.3 mg/L free chlorine at the plant outlet is RQEP (Q-2, r. 40) art. 8. The 0.2 mg/L in-tank figure and the turbidity limit are placeholders to confirm.

decay.note: First-order free-chlorine decay. Placeholder constants; calibrate with strip readings from real tanks.

trucksNote: Inukjuak has three water trucks (Nunatsiaq News 2024-05-27). 13,600 L is the Puvirnituq truck size (APTN 2025-11-10); Inukjuak's is not published.
householdTankNote: Household tank size is not published. 1,500 L is an assumption.
deliveryIntervalNote: Assumption. A 2025 Canadian Press piece says trucks aim for at least one delivery a day per house; two days is used so three trucks can cover the village in the simulation.
